name: Suzuki Alto
source:
The protagonist. A second-year student at Saint Mirowa Academy. A bit of a klutz. The type who gets swept along, prone to daydreaming.

He harbors feelings for his childhood friend, Harukaze Kurumi-chan, who attends the same academy, but he's too shy to clearly express his feelings. Because unlike Kurumi—beautiful, academically gifted, and popular in class—he feels inferior to his own dull self.

He used to have a strange ability to see people's romantic feelings floating above their heads, but that power is fading now. People say he resembles the amazing person from the Mirror World, ‘Lord Paul’.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080415135230/http://www.lucha-game.com/product/majokko/chara/ch_04.html]archived official site[/url]]
